abstract: A 43-year-old male presented with a left supraclavicular mass as well as an upper abdominal mass. Biopsy of the supraclavicular mass revealed seminoma with components of both embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma. Right orchiectomy was performed because physical examination showed that the left testis was normal but the right testis was slightly atrophic. The primary tumor which was approximately 1 cm in diameter was found in the right testis and histological examination revealed seminoma. When germ cell tumor is found in a region other than the gonads, either primary extragonadal germ cell tumor or occult testicular tumor is considered. To differentiate between the two, it is imperative to make careful histological exploration of the testes.
abstract_ja: 43歳の男性が、左鎖骨上窩腫瘤と上腹部腫瘤を呈して来院した。鎖骨上窩腫瘤の生検で、胎児性癌および絨毛癌の成分を伴うセミノーマが認められた。身体診察では左精巣は正常であったが右精巣がわずかに萎縮していたため、右精巣摘除術を施行した。直径約1cmの原発腫瘍が右精巣に認められ、病理組織学的検査でセミノーマと判明した。胚細胞腫瘍が性腺以外の部位で発見された場合には、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍か潜在性精巣腫瘍かを考慮する必要がある。両者を鑑別するためには、精巣の慎重な組織学的検索が不可欠である。
